title: Eunice
author: Gita Ryaboy
description:
Eunice is a shadow of its former glory.
Hope is lost, just a faint mem-ory
Whatever might have brought you here,
That Eunice needs you, it is clear.

Type out simple commands, and Notice the changes in Eunice land. Odd creatures and strange places require your aid. You'll get as much out as the efforts you made.
